$comment: OpenCatalogi's part of the Zuiddrecht example set, installed with `occ openregister:example-set:install zuiddrecht` (the loader lives in OpenRegister). A catalog for the municipality, themes that follow the subjects of the Zuiddrecht site, thirteen publications and the dossier and saved search of the example resident Sanne de Vries (cast key sanne). Every date is relative to the install day. The documents of each publication are in example-sets/zuiddrecht/<publication key>/, made by scripts/example-sets/make-zuiddrecht-documents.py; the loader cannot attach files to an object yet, so until it can they are not on the publications after an install. Dossiq's fragment runs after this one and finds the Woo decision by its title.
